title: Confessions of a 2-month vibe coder: I'm building a retro football manager browser game with AI
author: Dalimali
selftext:
Hi, I'm Dali, 45, software developer, and for about two months now I've been a vibe coder. 🙋

*(Sitting in a circle, folding chair, bad coffee.)* I have to admit: I'm having way too much fun.

For two months I've been letting AI build a football manager browser game, and I'm thrilled by what's possible. I'm also still learning a lot about the various AI tools.

**How it went**

* The first weeks: VS Code + DeepSeek with Cline. It got unstable (crashes) as the project grew, which was frustrating.
* Then DeepSeek raised its prices and I looked around. I landed on Claude Desktop and have worked with it ever since, on a plain Pro plan.
* It's a side project next to job and family, so the usage limits fit my free time surprisingly well.
* What I love most: remote-controlling the session from my phone. Step out into the garden, check the result of the last prompt, write the next one, pocket the phone. Done.
* Assets: for a while PixelLab, Gemini and ChatGPT. Lately Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 have been generating pixel assets themselves.

**About the game: Gaffer's Desk**

A 90s-style football manager in the browser (think classic *On the Ball* / *Championship Manager*), in pixel art. I grew up loving those games and played them for hours and hours. The UI comes in English plus 27 more languages (thanks, AI!).

Some core features:

* Matches run as a live tick simulation with a 2D replay (set pieces, offside, weather, penalty shootouts)
* Leagues in 50+ countries, national cups, a Global Championship for clubs from around the world, and a Nations Trophy for national teams. The top managers of each country's league get to coach their nation for one season.
* Auction-style transfer market, stadium building, training, youth, finances
* A daily newspaper generated for your club
* A sticker album to collect
* Everything is computed once a day: log in, make some adjustments, and see the results the next day. It fits a casual routine.

I'd love your feedback and please go easy on my "AI approach"! 😄
